title: A Tour of My GitHub: 10 Projects With Full Code (Java, Python, AI, Backend)
description:
A quick tour of my GitHub profile, and every project on it comes with the full source code and a detailed README.

What you'll find:
🎟️ SeatLock: a ticket-booking backend that never double-books a seat (Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka)
🔍 RootLens: finds why a microservice broke and rolls back the bad release (Python, FastAPI, Prometheus)
📨 TriageIQ: an AI support inbox that runs fully on-device (Kafka, local LLM, RAG)
🧵 GitLoom: turns any GitHub profile into a portfolio website (JavaScript)
🦷 Dental X-ray AI: detects 31 dental conditions with YOLOv9
🦯 Smart Walker (patent filing in progress), RL hazard rover, Smart Grocer and more
♟️ Plus a chess game you can play right inside the README

💻 Get the code: https://github.com/HemashreeVI
🗂️ Portfolio: https://hemashreevi.github.io

scenes.title: hero
lines: I'm Hemashree, a computer science engineering student at VIT Chennai. I build systems that see, decide, and keep people safe.

scenes.title: about

lines: My approach is simple: sense, decide, protect. And the journey goes from VIT, to research, to Singapore for NUS and SuperAI, to co-inventing a patent.

scenes.title: work1
lines: Then the projects. Dental X-ray AI that spots thirty one conditions. And SeatLock, a booking system that never sells the same seat twice.

scenes.title: work2
lines: RootLens, which finds out why production broke and rolls back the bad release. TriageIQ, an AI support inbox that runs on a laptop. And GitLoom, which turns any GitHub into a website.
